versions.changelog:
Initial release of artifacts-builder: tools for creating multi-component claude.ai artifacts.

- Provides a scaffold for building complex artifacts using React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
- Includes scripts to initialize a new project and bundle it into a single HTML file for sharing.
- Pre-configures 40+ shadcn/ui components, Radix UI dependencies, path aliases, and Vite/Parcel setups.
- Offers clear development and design guidelines to ensure clean, modern outputs.
- Emphasizes avoiding overused visual styles ("AI slop") and unnecessary testing steps for faster artifact delivery.
